choose.when:
order by
ct.display_name ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
c.`name` ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
ct.`owner` ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
ct.display_amount ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
ct.`alreadyPayAmount` ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
ct.display_stage ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
ct.`create_time` ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
ct.`update_time` ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
ct.`create_user` ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
ct.`update_user` ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
ct.display_signer_dept_id ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
ct.`approval_status` ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
ct.display_start_time ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
ct.display_end_time ${sortType}, ct.id ASC
CASE WHEN module_table.type = 'INPUT_NUMBER' THEN COALESCE(sort_version_table.field_value, sort_table.field_value)+0 END ${sortType}, COALESCE(sort_version_table.field_value, sort_table.field_value) ${sortType}, ct.id ${sortType}
choose.otherwise: order by ct.create_time desc, ct.id asc

mapper.select: SELECT ct.id, ct.NAME, ct.customer_id, c.`name` AS customerName, c.in_shared_pool AS inCustomerPool, c.pool_id, ct.amount, ct.approval_status, ct.stage, ct.`owner`, ct.void_reason, ct.create_user, ct.create_time, ct.update_user, ct.update_time FROM contract ct LEFT JOIN customer c ON ct.customer_id = c.id where ct.id = #{id}
